details:
I am a mod for two groups and an owner of several of my own. Below I have listed a few, seemingly easy to implement Group moderation features that I think would benefit everyone, or as many people as possible.

1. Ban Specific Avatars.

Let's say you have a Group Public instance running, staffed with four mods, and featuring a range of ages for mon-mod instance members, including minors. Suddenly, fifteen people in KKK avatars show up and start harassing people. It's one thing to ban all fifteen, but it does diddly squat if anyone not apart of the original fifteen can just wear said offensive avatar and enter the instance. My proposal is to add an option to ban the avatar specifically from being used in the instance, with a spot to log for other mods a simple reason why, like some premade options such as Offensive or Nudity or Crasher as well as a slot for Other that someone has to fill in themselves, plus an option to just also route that group moderation decision ino a VRC moderation ticket as well that reports both avatar and creator for the supplied reason(s). This will save groups who get swarmed by a specific avatar, and recorded during said swarm, from having rando VRC users from just donning the bad avatar and causing more trouble. When the avatar is banned, any users wearing it are forcefully swapped into a default robot avatar; bonus points if avatar switching is halted for the next five to fifteen minutes for that user who just got forced to the default bot.

2. Group Staff Tag.

A simple option to, when in a group ran instance, the tag [group name] Staff is placed above the head of anyone who is marked as a moderator/admin for the group, or even one placed under the username; will also show up in the user bio and instance list. Why? 'Cause it'll help regular group members be able to easily locate staff say they need help. A lot of people, myself included, use completely new groups for the sole purpose of having a staff tag above their heads so members can find staff as quickly as possible. Bonus points if this staff tag can be customized, within reason, to use custom role names, such as how in my group, admins are called Overseers due to both the synthwave vibe my group has and their purpose in the group.

3. Prohibit Portals from Non-Group Staff.

I remember there was once a time were people used to hack VRC and make it spam portals in random places, just to send people to who knows where. That being said, having the ability to, just like with prints and items, turn off the ability for non-marked group roles, like anyone who isn't at least a moderator, from spawning portals would prevent people from using said hacked exploits, or even just placing a portal down to a NSFW world while in a PG-13 instance, will help immensely.

4. Custom Warning Messages.

Sometimes, people will come up to me and ask why they got a warning. Usually it's for something like being offensive, or wearing an avatar the group doesn't approve of, or getting too political. Being able to just select from a bunch of pre-written options, like for harassment, disregarding personal space, or being too loud, would be nice, on top of an Other option that just lets you type a short message that follows "You have been given a warning for", and is followed by "Please be respectful and do not do it again," or something similar. Additionally, warnings should have a "You have been warned X time(s)" section, and count up accordingly; bonus points if you can set how many warnings someone can get before being auto kicked.

5. Warned and... Options.

Sometimes someone will not listen to you no matter what. Being able to send a warning and bundle it with, say, having their mic globally muted for fifteen minutes would be nice. Setup would be just like making a warning, but have a few optional tick boxes for if you want to include having the person being warned be globally mic muted for a set period of time and/or have their chatbox globally turned off for a set period of time, maybe even revoke the user's right to prints/stickers/items for a set period, with times ranging from things like fifteen/thirty/forty-five minutes, or even to "Until Leaving Instance." Additionally, just having the option to set how long you want to instance mute someone's mic and/or chatbox would be nice.
title: Five Suggestions for Group Moderation Features
